Who this article is for: travelers using the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways.

Companion Animal Travel Desk: planning for pet travel

This guide helps you prepare a companion animal for travel with Aurelia Skyways, so the process feels clear and manageable. The Companion Animal Travel Desk supports passengers before departure, and the senior coordinator helps keep service decisions consistent for each trip.

Before you travel, review the basic requirements for your animal's carrier, documents, and check-in needs. It is also wise to keep your pet calm, hydrated, and comfortable while you organize the trip. If you are traveling with a cat or dog, bring familiar items that may help your animal settle more easily.

At the airport, follow the signs and ask staff for the correct pet area if you need direction. The right space can make a stressful day easier for both you and your animal. <<FACT F021>> In some cases, you may be guided to a lounge or relief area before boarding, and staff can help you understand where to go next.

If your travel plans include extra screening or temporary holding, listen closely to the staff instructions and keep all paperwork within reach. <<FACT F028>> Clear communication at the desk helps avoid delays and supports a smoother handoff. <<FACT F013>> When you arrive at your destination, collect your animal promptly and check that everything is as expected.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk or speak with Aurelia Skyways staff before you depart.
